name: Interrupted-CAS ancestry recovery + proportionality cleanups
goal: Fix I1 (interrupted-CAS recovery must detect 'already landed' by ancestry, not exact equality, so a landed-then-advanced row is completed rather than stranded) and fold in 4 SAFE proportionality cleanups. Folds into unpushed v1.1.11.

tasks.name: C1 (I1 ancestry fix) + C5 (persistRecoveryRef dedup) — integration.ts + tests
tasks.description: reconcile crash branch + reopenForEdit guard must detect 'already landed' by ancestry (isAncestor(candidate, currentTarget)) not exact equality; the primary-checkout verify/repair is gated on currentTarget===candidate. NO worktreeHead conjunct on the guard (R1: refuse when landed AND lock held; a HEAD gate would strand a genuine post-CAS-recommit row). C5: extract persistRecoveryRef helper. TDD for C1.

steps.description: RED: in integration-cases.ts recovery part add two cases with a landed-then-advanced interrupted-CAS seed (model on advancedWithoutRecord ~:1958-1975 which reaches markIntegrated): setup(false); commit reviewed work -> landed; oldTarget=git(root,'rev-parse','HEAD'); update-ref frozen=landed; acquireIntegrationLock(database,{repositoryIdentity,workspaceGuid,targetRef:'refs/heads/main',expectedTarget:oldTarget}); git(root,'merge','--ff-only',landed); update-ref candidate=landed; set lifecycle_status='ready_for_integration' (base_commit=oldTarget, frozen=landed so the effect proof holds); THEN advance target: git(root,'commit','--allow-empty','-m','unrelated advance'). Case A: expect(reconcileFinalization(database,{repositoryPath:root,workspaceGuid,providerRootSessionId:OWNER}).state).toBe('cleaned') and integratedCommit===landed [RED: throws 'Crash reconciliation target is not the exact candidate']. Case B: expect(() => reconcileFinalization(database,{...,rebaseRecovery:'reopen_for_edit'})).toThrow('integration already landed on the target'); assert candidate ref, frozen ref, integration_locks row survive [RED: equality guard doesn't fire so reopen proceeds]. Keep existing exact-target cases passing.
steps.expected: RED: Case A throws 'not the exact candidate'; Case B does not throw (reopen proceeds). Existing core + recovery cases pass.

steps.description: GREEN C1 reconcile crash branch (integration.ts ~:2206-2242): (a) replace `if (currentTarget !== candidate) throw new Error('Crash reconciliation target is not the exact candidate; preserving worktree');` with `if (!isAncestor(exact.primaryCheckoutPath, candidate, currentTarget)) { throw new Error('Crash reconciliation candidate did not land on the target; preserving worktree'); }`. (b) wrap the existing `try { verifyPrimaryAfterFastForward(exact.primaryCheckoutPath, ref, expectedTarget, candidate); } catch { repairPrimaryCheckoutAfterInterruptedCas(exact.primaryCheckoutPath, ref, expectedTarget, candidate); }` block in `if (currentTarget === candidate) { … }`. Leave requireExactIntegrationLock, the effect proof, markIntegrated(candidate,ref), disposition check, recycleFinalized, and the ~:2192 sourceHead!==candidate gate unchanged.

GREEN C1 reopenForEdit guard (integration.ts ~:1951-1964): replace the guard body with: `let landedCandidate: string | undefined; try { landedCandidate = runGit(exact.primaryCheckoutPath, ['rev-parse','--verify',`${candidateRef(assignment.workspace_guid)}^{commit}`]).trim(); } catch {} if (landedCandidate) { const landed = isAncestor(exact.primaryCheckoutPath, landedCandidate, targetRef(assignment)); const lockHeld = db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM integration_locks WHERE repository_identity = ? AND workspace_guid = ?').get(assignment.repository_identity, assignment.workspace_guid) !== undefined; if (landed && lockHeld) { throw new Error('reopen_for_edit refused: integration already landed on the target (interrupted-CAS); run reconcile — it will finish the integration or report the repair needed — do not reopen'); } }` (NO worktreeHead conjunct; subsumes the lineage-118 unresolvable-target try/catch; isAncestor already imported).

GREEN C5: extract persistRecoveryRef(db, exact, oid, residualFiles) — create-only `update-ref <recoveryRef> <oid> ''` (same-oid-tolerant catch) + `UPDATE assignments SET recovery_ref` + insertPreservedWork({kind:'recovery',payload:{ref,residualFiles}}) + re-verify rev-parse — and call it from both snapshotResidualIfDirty (~:1498-1521) and reopenForEdit's clean-diverged-HEAD branch (~:1979-1996). Behavior identical.
